text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After his adventure with Misato, {0} obtained the flower seeds he had been searching for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサトとの冒険の末、
花の種を手に入れた{0}。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: That's right. Plant the seeds there, then gently cover them with soil.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう。
そこに種を撒いて、
優しく土をかけてあげて。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: After that, make sure to give them plenty of water.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとは
お水をしっかりと飲ませてあげてね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yes, very good. Now all we have to do is wait for the sprouts to appear.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
よくできました。
これであとは
芽が出るのを待つだけよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: From now on, let's make sure not to forget to water them every day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これから毎日、
忘れずに
お水をあげましょうね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Umm, let's see... The Elven Forest has nutrient-rich soil and a very good environment for growing plants, so I think they'll be fine as long as you water them properly every day~
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
そうねぇ……
エルフの森は
土も栄養たっぷりで
植物を育てやすい環境だから、
毎日ちゃんとお水をあげれば大丈夫だと思うけど～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah. There is one more important thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
一つ、
大切なものがあるわね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: It doesn't apply solely to flowers, but pretty much everything... An ingredient absolutely necessary whenever you're "raising" or "growing" something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お花だけじゃなくて、
どんなものにでも……
『なにかを育てる』ときに必ず必要なもの。

text_block_list.name: ミサト
text_block_list.text: ─愛情よ。
text_block_list.orig_text: ─愛情よ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Uhuhu. Maybe that doesn't quite click for you yet? But... this is something you must never forget.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
まだピンとこないかしら？
でもね、
これは忘れちゃいけないものなの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: {0}-kun, please take good care of them with love. If you do, I'm sure these flowers will respond to those feelings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君も愛情を込めてお世話をしてみてね。
そうすればきっと、
このお花も応えてくれるはずだから。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day.
text_block_list.orig_text: 次の日。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Another day begins~♪ Now then, I need to get everything ready before the children arrive. Toys, picture books, and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日も一日の始まりね～♪
さ、
子どもたちが来る前に準備をしなくっちゃ。
遊び道具と絵本を持って、
と……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my? {0}-kun... Good morning. You're up quite early today, aren't you? You usually come around the same time as the other children...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あら？　
{0}君……
おはよう。
今日はずいぶん早いのね？
いつもは他の子どもたちが集まる頃に来るのに……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? You're here to water the flowers? Oh my, aren't you eager~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
水やり？
あらあら、
気が早いわね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. You've got a cute little cowlick in your hair, you know? Did you rush over here that quickly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
頭にかわいい寝ぐせができてるわよ？
そんなに急いで来てくれたの？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I usually take care of the morning watering all at once myself, so you really didn't have to work this hard...
text_block_list.orig_text:
朝の分は
いつも私がまとめてあげているから、
そんなに頑張らなくてもいいのに……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Uhuhu. But you did well... Since you're here, why don't we go together, {0}-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
でもそうね。
せっかくだから{0}君も一緒に行きましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me. Have you eaten breakfast? You won't have enough energy for the day if you don't eat properly. Why don't you eat together with Sensei?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだわ、
朝ご飯は食べた？
ちゃんと食べないと
一日の元気がでないわよ。
先生と一緒に食べましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The following day.
text_block_list.orig_text: また次の日。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Did you wake up early again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
また早起きして来てくれたの？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You're such a hard worker. I'm sure your flowers are delighted to have you care for them like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頑張り屋さんね。
きっと
{0}君のお花も喜んでくれているはずよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: However... they don't need any water today. It rained last night, remember?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど
今日はお水はいいの。
昨日の夜、
雨が降ったでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: If you give them too much water, the flowers' little bellies will get too full. It's the same as when you eat too much and start feeling sluggish, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お水をたくさんあげすぎると、
お花も
お腹がいっぱいになっちゃうのよ。
あなたも食べ過ぎると、
動きが鈍くなっちゃうでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Uhuhu. But since you came all this way, would you help Sensei out instead?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
でもせっかく来てくれたんだから、
先生のお手伝いをしてもらえないかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: The ground is wet so we can't play outside today... instead, I think we'll practice singing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
地面が濡れてて
今日はお外で遊べないから、
その代わりに
みんなでお歌の練習をしようと思うの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: When teaching songs to the children, it's really helpful when you take the lead and sing along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子どもたちにお歌を教えるとき、
{0}君が率先して声を出してくれると
助かるわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Some of them are shy, so please set an example for them...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
照れ屋さんな子もいるから、
あなたがその子たちのお手本になってあげてね……♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few more days later...
text_block_list.orig_text: さらに数日後。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You're getting better at watering, aren't you? The flowers look so happy and sparkling♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お水のあげ方、
上手になってきたわね～
お花が楽しそうにキラキラしてるわ♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you're talking to them too? ...So you asked Aoi-chan for tips on how to help them bloom.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
話しかけてあげてるの？
……アオイちゃんに咲かせるコツを聞いたのね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Well then, I guess I'll join you. Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
私も
お話ししちゃおうかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hello little flowers~♪ Grow up healthy and strong, just like the children do~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お花のみんな～♪
元気に、
子どもたちと同じように
すくすくと伸びていってね～♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my? What's that? What a strangely colored liquid...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
それはなぁに？
変わった色の液体だけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: A nutritional supplement made by someone you know? To think such a concoction existed~
text_block_list.orig_text:
知り合いの人が作ってくれた栄養剤？
そんなものがあるのね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: But... are you sure it's safe? Look at its dark green color... and how it's bubbling vehemently...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
本当に大丈夫？
濃い緑色で、
なんだか常にブクブクいってるけど……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: However, even after all that attention, not a single bud appeared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──しかし、
一向に花の芽は出なかった。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Several days have passed since then, but the sprouts still haven't appeared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれから何日か経ったけど、
まだ芽は出ないわね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I would've thought they'd start peeking out by now...
text_block_list.orig_text: そろそろ顔を出してもいい頃だと思うのに……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Why won't they sprout, I wonder? The Elven Forest should be the perfect environment for plants...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうして芽が出ないのかしら？
エルフの森は
植物にとっていい環境のはずなのに……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Even if we wanted to ask Aoi-chan, the sprouts haven't come out yet, so we can't hear what the flowers are saying.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アオイちゃんに聞いてみようにも、
まだ芽が出てないから
お花さんの声を聞くこともできないわよね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... these are flowers that are especially difficult to bloom. Could it be they simply can't bloom in the Elven Forest...? But if that's true, then all his hard work...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしたら、
咲かせるのがとても難しいお花なのかしら。
エルフの森じゃ咲かないの……？
でもそんなの、
頑張ってるあの子には…

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hey, little flowers. I want you to answer all the effort he's been putting in every single day...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
お花さん。
あの子の毎日の頑張りに、
応えてあげてほしいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah! S-So you've arrived?! ...Good morning. You're up early again today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
い……
いたの！？
……おはよう。
今日も早いわね～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you're not pushing yourself too hard, are you? You always come in early in the morning and stay up late looking after those flowers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねぇ、
無理はしてない？
いつも朝早く来て、
遅くまでずっとお花たちを見てくれてるけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Say, could it be that... you're getting anxious?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねぇ。
もしかして、
焦ってないかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I see... as I thought, you're worried that the buds aren't sprouting yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう……
やっぱり、
なかなか芽が出ないことを気にしているのね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: It's okay, there's nothing to worry about. The fact that the buds haven't sprouted yet is proof that the flowers are working hard right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫よ、
心配いらないわ。
芽が出ないのは、
お花がいま頑張っている証拠よ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: So... try to be a little more cheerful! If you look so gloomy, {0}-kun, the flowers might feel too shy to show their faces too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……だから、
もっと明るい顔をしましょう。
{0}君が暗い顔をしていたら、
お花も顔を出しづらくなってしまうわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...Okay?

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: That's not true... Absolutely not.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは違う……
絶対に違うわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Every day, you wake up early for these flowers, ask all sorts of people for advice, get their help, and do everything you possibly can for them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたはこのお花のために
毎日早起きして、
いろんな人に話を聞いて、
協力してもらって、
自分にできることをなんでもやっているもの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Your efforts, your care... they are not misplaced.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その頑張りは、
なによりも正しいものよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I know it must have made you anxious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね……
不安になっちゃったわよね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: But believe me. Your love is not wrong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも信じて。
あなたの愛情は
間違ってなんてない。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: There are still so many things this boy doesn't understand. I spoke so casually about love... and because the flowers haven't sprouted, I ended up making him worry that his love wasn't enough... that it was somehow wrong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子には
まだわからないことがたくさんある。
私が簡単に
愛情なんて言ってしまったから……
芽が出ないことで、
自分の愛情が足りない、
間違ってるなんて、
不安にさせちゃったのね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Even though understanding "himself" is the most difficult thing for him... and also the most important.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子にとって、
『自分のこと』は一番難しくて、
……大切なものなのに。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...I need to teach him. Even if it's hard to put into words, I'll do everything I can...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……教えてあげなくちゃ。
言葉にするのは難しいけれど、
私の
できる限りで……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hey... stay just like that for a moment, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと……
そのまま動かないでね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...How is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
どう？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I wonder if you can sense my feelings... if only a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の気持ち……
少しでも、
感じ取れているかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: This is... love.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが……
愛情。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I want you to smile. I want you to grow up healthy. I want to show you how much I cherish you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたに笑顔でいてほしい。
あなたが元気に育ってほしい。
あなたを大切だっていう想い。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Those are the very feelings you're pouring your heart into those flowers with right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたが今、
あのお花に一生懸命注いでいる気持ちよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I wonder... if it reached you. My love...
text_block_list.orig_text:
伝わる……
かしら？
私の愛情……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Is this... your power...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは……
あなたの、
力……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: And it's not only for me. It's spreading through my body... into the forest...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私だけじゃない。
私の体を通して……
森に広がっていく……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: What a warm, gentle power...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんて温かい、
優しい力……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: It looks like the entire forest is happy... I've never seen anything like this before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
森が喜んでるみたい……
こんなの、
見たことない……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Look! The flower bed...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て！
花壇の方……！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I am certain... your love must have reached them...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ……！
きっと、
あなたの愛情が届いたのね……！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... Really. Hehehehe...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった……
本当に。
うふふふふ……♪

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaah! Misato-sensei's hugging Onii-chan so tightly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー！
ミサト先生、
おにいちゃんギュ～
ってしてるー！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Awawa, you can't! You should give them some privacy at times like these!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あわわ、
だめだよ、
こういう時はそっとしておかなくちゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Huh? Eh!? Everyone, why...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
えっ！？
みんな、
どうして……

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: You weren't around Misato-sensei, so we thought you'd be here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサト先生がいないから、
ここかな～
って！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we all came looking for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
みんなで探しに来たんだー

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Oh my, oh my! It's already that late?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あらあらあら！
もっ、
もうそんな時間！？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: T-This scene... it's not what it looks like, okay? My love, um...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっ、
これはね、
違うのよ？
愛情をね、
その……

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah! So you ARE being all lovey-dovey!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーっ！
ラブラブだー！！！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Misato-sensei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサト先生、
おめでと～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Aahhh... Oh my, oh my...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
あらあらあらあら……！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: W-What should I do? Geez, you're all way too precocious...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしたらいいかしら？
もう、
みんなおませさんなんだから……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The Elven Forest is engulfed in laughter. Even the newly sprouted life in the flower bed was swaying cheerfully.
text_block_list.orig_text:
笑い声に包まれるエルフの森。
花壇に新しく芽吹いた一つの命も、楽しそうに揺れているのであった。
